subject: Bluecrest site trip — propose split-format demo + office hours
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@bluecrest.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Bluecrest site trip — demo timing and format?

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for organizing the site week. I heard you're going to be traveling through three cities that week, which sounds hectic. To make the most of the short windows you mentioned, I wanted to propose two options so we don't lose momentum on the evaluation:

Option A — Focused live demo (45 min) during a single stop:
- Full product walkthrough tailored to your use cases (25 min)
- Short technical deep-dive + Q&A (20 min)

Option B — Split format (25 + 30):
- 25-min focused demo recorded ahead of time (we'll send the recording)
- 30-min live office hours during a stop for questions and integration checks

I've attached a quick draft agenda (Bluecrest_demo_agenda_v1.pdf) and added a HubSpot note to the deal. If helpful, we can also bring Marcus for the integration questions on the office hours call.

Can you share the tightest windows you have on Sep 21–24 (local times) and whether you'd prefer Option A or B? If neither works, we can propose a short async workflow plus a 20-min sync while you're in-transit.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.inference | +1 (555) 321-9987

Attachments: Bluecrest_demo_agenda_v1.pdf
From: Elena Martinez <elena@bluecrest.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluecrest site trip — demo timing and format?

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for outlining options. Our VP, Ana, just compressed her itinerary — she now has only short pockets (20–30 minutes) between press briefings and a partner reception. We are trying to avoid adding full 45-min blocks where possible.

Prefer Option B (split) in principle. A recorded 25-min demo we can watch on the flight would be perfect, followed by a 30-min live office-hours window. The challenge: the only realistic in-person window is Sep 22 between 15:10–15:40 PT (tight) while we're between cities. Alternatively, Sep 23 morning (09:00–10:00 PT) is open but Ana will be on a conference floor and might step out.

Also: who will be on the office-hours call? We may bring one of our SREs — they'd like to ask about data residency and dedicated capacity. Any pricing implications for a short technical session?

Appreciate the flexibility — Elena
Elena Martinez
BD Lead, Bluecrest AI
elena@bluecrest.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@bluecrest.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bluecrest site trip — demo timing and format?

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the details. We can absolutely do the split approach and tailor the office-hours to the SRE questions. Quick proposals below — both designed to fit short transit windows: 

Option 1 (tight transit window) — Sep 22
- We'll send a 25-min recorded demo by EOD Sep 21.
- Live office-hours: 30 min on Sep 22 at 15:10 PT. Format: 10-min focused infra Q&A, 15-min integration checklist, 5-min next steps.

Option 2 (safer window) — Sep 23
- Send recording by EOD Sep 22.
- Live office-hours: 09:00 PT on Sep 23 — slightly more flexible if Ana can step out.

On the SRE questions: Marcus (cc'd) will join the office-hours. Short answers on data residency and Dedicated capacity:
- Data residency: we support region-specific deployments and can provide a SOC2-compliant diagram and ARchive retention notes.
- Dedicated capacity pricing: short technical calls don't change pricing — capacity and commits are a separate contract discussion. For now we'll note that an on-call engineer and a post-demo architecture brief can be added if you want a deeper dive.

Attached is a quick split plan with talking points (Bluecrest_demo_split_plan.pdf). If you confirm which option you prefer, Rishi will send calendar invites and the recording link.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference

Attachments: Bluecrest_demo_split_plan.pdf

Perfect — thanks Elena and Soojin. Elena, sounds like Option 1 (Sep 22 at 15:10 PT) is the tightest match. If that works for Ana we will:

- Send the 25-min recording by 23:59 PT on Sep 21.
- Book a 30-min office-hours block for Sep 22 at 15:10 PT (calendar invite to follow).
- Marcus will handle the SRE questions; Soojin and I will cover product and integration.
- We'll upload the recording and the SOC2/architecture stub to the Drive link and add HubSpot notes with the assets.

If Ana confirms, please reply with the single best attendee email to put on the invite (so it doesn't get lost in transit). We'll also prepare a short one-page summary for procurement in case you want pricing highlights ahead of time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Rishi
